channel.description: Recent content in Free Software and Resources Sheets on OfiLibre URJC english

item.title: Maximum
item.description: Maxima is an open-source computer algebra system. It consists of a powerful symbolic calculation engine, programmed in Lisp language.

item.title: OBS
item.description: Open Broadcaster Software (OBS) is a free and open-source application for video recording and live internet broadcasting.

item.title: Horton
item.description: Horton is basically a Python library that can be used to calculate structures and to interpret these calculations.

item.title: Easy68k
item.description: Easy68k is an IDE for creating, editing, and executing programs written in assembly code for Motorola 68000 on a Windows PC or in Wine without the need for any additional hardware.

item.title: Lazarus
item.description: Lazarus is a multi-platform IDE compatible with Delphi for Free Pascal.

item.title: Bestia
item.description: BEAST is a multi-platform program for Bayesian analysis of molecular sequences using MCMC.

item.title: OpenOffice
item.description: Apache OpenOffice is a free, open-source office suite that includes a word processor, spreadsheet, presentations, vector drawing tools, and a database.

item.title: Processing
item.description: Processing is an open-source programming language and integrated development environment based on Java, easy to use, and serving as a means for teaching and producing multimedia and interactive digital design projects.

item.title: SWIProlog
item.description: SWI-Prolog is an open-source implementation of the Prolog programming language. SWI-Prolog features a rich set of characteristics, libraries (including its own GUI library, XPCE), tools (including an IDE) and extensive documentation.

item.title: Anaconda
item.description: Anaconda is a free and open distribution of the Python and R languages, used in data science and machine learning.

item.title: Autopsy
item.description: Autopsy is a forensic analysis tool that allows for the identification and discovery of relevant information in data sources such as hard drive images, USB memories, network traffic captures, or computer memory dumps.

item.title: Cryptool
item.description: CrypTool is a free software that illustrates cryptographic concepts. It is the most widely used electronic learning program in the world in the field of cryptography.

item.title: Notepad++
item.description: Notepad++ is a free text and source code editor with support for several programming languages.

item.title: BlueJ
item.description: BlueJ was developed to support the teaching and learning of object-oriented programming, and as a result, its design differs from other development environments.

item.title: Netbeans
item.description: NetBeans is a free integrated development environment, mainly designed for the Java programming language.

item.title: Arduino
item.description: Arduino is an easy and affordable way for beginners and professionals to create devices that can interact with their environment through sensors and actuators.

item.title: Inkscape
item.description: Inkscape is an open-source vector graphics editor, with capabilities similar to Illustrator, Freehand, CorelDraw or Xara X, which uses the W3C standard: the Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) file format.

item.title: KeePass
item.description: A password manager or administrator is a computer program used to store a large number of username/password pairs.

item.title: ArgoUML
item.description: It is a tool for program modeling through diagrams, fundamentally UML.

item.title: Audacity
item.description: Application for recording, converting, and editing audio. It works with formats such as Ogg Vorbis, MP3, WAV, AIFF, AU, LOF, and WMP.

item.title: Mars
item.description: Interactive development environment for programming in assembly language for MIPS. It was created with didactic purposes by the University of Missouri.

item.title: Ultimaker Cura
item.description: Software fundamentally used in the transformation of 3D models (obj, stl, x3d…) into a valid format for 3D printing (gcode).

item.title: Wireshark
item.description: It is a protocol analyzer used to perform analysis and troubleshoot problems in communication networks, for software and protocol development, and as a didactic tool.

item.title: 7zip
item.description: 7-Zip is a free file archiver developed by Igor Pavlov. By default, it uses the 7z file format, also free, (with a .

item.title: GIMP
item.description: Gimp is a program for editing digital images in bitmap format.

item.title: Greenfoot
item.description: Greenfoot is an interactive Java development environment for educational purposes. It allows the creation of two-dimensional graphical applications, such as simulations and games.

item.title: Protect
item.description: Protégé is a free open-source editor and a knowledge acquisition system.

item.title: Octave
item.description: Octave or GNU Octave is a program and programming language for performing numerical calculations.
